description: Equipement public équipé de chargeur USB ou borne WIFI is a dataset listed in DataHub Métropole de Bordeaux open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Bordeaux Métropole. Dictionnaire Public Ce jeu de données représente sous forme de points les mobiliers urbains (abri bus, stations bus express, banc connecté, mât de recharge solaire) et lieux publics (quais, piscines, bibliothèques…) disposant d'un accès Wifi gratuit en extérieur (outdoor) et/ou de recharges USB. Coverage: Bordeaux Métropole. The portal files it under Infrastructure IT. Its keywords are data-gouv, Wifi, équipement public, Mobilier urbain, recharges USB, connecté. The portal shows 81 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-datahub-bordeaux-metropole-fr-portal.
